senses.gloss: 1 पु॑र् f. fullness, abundance (only पूर्भि॑स्).

2 पु॑र् (nom. पू॑र्) f. stronghold, castle, (fortified) town;
the body.
पुर n. ई f. the same.
पुरउष्णिह् f. N. of a metre.
पुरएतृ॑ m. who goes before, leader.
पुरजन m. townsfolk.
पुरजित् m. the conqueror of castles, E. of Śiva.
पुरंजय m. N. of sev. heroes (lit. = prec.).

पुरतस् adv. & prep. in front, before (sp. & t.), in
presence of (gen. or —˚).
पुरद्वार n. a city-gate.

पुरंदर॑ m. E. of sev. gods (lit. destroyer of
castles).
पुरंध्रि f. wife, woman.
पुरं˚ध्री f. wife, woman.
पुरभिद् m. of Śiva (lit. = पुरंदर॑).
पुर˚मथन m. of Śiva (lit. = पुरंदर॑).
पुर˚मथितृ m. of Śiva (lit. = पुरंदर॑).
पु॑रय m. N. of a man.
पुररक्ष m. watchman of a town.
पुर˚रक्षिन् m. watchman of a town.
पुरराष्ट्र (˚—) town and country.
पुरवासिन् m. city-dweller, townsman.

पुर॑स् adv. in front, forward, before (also prep. w. gen.,
abl., acc., or —˚);
 eastward, at first. With गम् go first, take the
lead. — Cf. 1 कृ & धा.
पुरस्कार m. preference, veneration, honour.

पुरस्कृत्य ger. having placed before or appointed,
having paid respect to;
 as adv. or prep. with regard to, on account of,
about (acc.).

पुर॑स्तात् adv. in front, before, eastward or from the
east, at first, previously (also as prep. w. gen., abl., acc., or —˚).

पुरस्तान्मुख a. having the face turned towards,
looking into a person's face.*
पुरःस॑द् a. sitting in front or towards the east.

पुरःसर॑ f. ई going before, preceding. m.
forerunner, attendant, servant;
 adj. preceded or accompanied by,
connected with, n. adv. with, after (—˚).

पुरःस्थ a. evident, clear (lit. standing before, scil.
one's eyes).
पुराकल्प m. the past or a tale of the past.

पुराकृत a. done before;
 n. former deed.
पुराजा॑ a. existing from of old.

पूरण a. (f. ई) & n. (पू॑रण) making full,
completing, accomplishing, satisfying;
 m. & f. ई an ordinal number in
the masc. & fem. gender (g.).
पुराणव॑त् adv. as of old.
पुराणवि॑द् a. knowing past things.
पुराणविद्या f. ˚वेद m. abstr. to prec.
पुराणसंहिता f. collection of the Purāṇas.
पुराधि॑प m. governor of a city, prefect of police.
पुराध्यक्ष m. governor of a city, prefect of police.
पुरारि m. E. of Śiva or Viṣṇu (lit. foe of the castles).
पुराविद् a. knowing past things.
पुरिशय॑ a. resting in the body.
पुरीत॑त् m. n. the pericardium, intestine i.g.

पुरीषि॑न् a. dwelling in or on the earth;
 earthy, muddy.

पुरी˚ष्य॑ a. dwelling in or on the earth;
 earthy, muddy.
पुरुकु॑त्स m. a man's name.
पुरुकु॑त्सानी f. the wife of Purukutsa.
पुरुकृ॑त् a. doing much, active, busy, efficacious.
पुरु˚कृ॑त्वन् a. doing much, active, busy, efficacious.

पुरुक्षु॑ a. rich in food, i.g. abundant in, liberal with
(gen.).
पुरुजित् m. a man's name.
पुरुत्रा॑ adv. in many places or ways, variously, often.
पुरुदं॑स a. rich in wonders or deeds.
पुरु˚दं॑सस् a. rich in wonders or deeds.
†पुरुदत्र a. rich in gifts.
पुरुद्रप्स॑ a. rich in drops, dropping.
पुरुध॑ adv. in many ways, variously, frequently.
पुरु˚धा॑ adv. in many ways, variously, frequently.
पुरुप्रिय॑ a. beloved of many.
पुरुप्रै॑ष a. inciting many.
पुरु˚प्रैष॑ a. inciting many.
†पुरुभुज् a. possessing much.
पुरुमित्र॑ m. a man's name (friend of many).
पुरुरू॑प a. multiform, many-coloured.
पुरुवी॑र a. rich in men (children or followers).
पुरुशा॑क a. helpful, powerful.
पुरुश्चन्द्र॑ a. shining much or bright.
पू॑रुष v. पु॑रुष.
पुरुषाकार a. of human form.
पुरुषकेसरिन् m. man-lion (E. of Viṣṇu).
पुरुषज्ञान n. knowledge of men.

पुरुष॑ता f. manhood, manliness;
 as instr. adv. = seq.
पुरुषत्रा॑ adv. among men or in the manner of men.
पुरुषत्व n. manhood, virility.

पुरुषपशु m. a man as a sacrificial victim or a beast
of a man.

पुरुषमानिन् a. thinking one's self a man or hero;
abstr. ˚नित्व n.
पुरुषमृग॑ m. the male of the antelope.
पुरुषमेध॑ m. the sacrifice of a man.
पुरुषर्षभ m. man-bull, i.e. excellent man.
पुरुषवर m. the best of men, E. of Viṣṇu.

पु॑रुषविध a. man-like;
 abstr. ˚ता† f.
पुरुषव्याघ्र॑ m. man-tiger, excellent man.
पुरुषसिंह m. man-lion, hero.
पुरुषा॑द् a. eating or consuming men.

पुरुषाद् f. ई = prec.;
 m. a Rakṣas.
पूरुषा॑द् a. eating men.
पुरुषादक a. & m. the same.
पुरुषानृत n. falsehood regarding a human being.
पुरुषी॑ v. पु॑रुष.
पुरुष्टुत॑ a. praised by men.
पुरुष्य॑ a. human.

पुरुहूत॑ a. invoked by many;
 m. E. of Indra.

पुरूची॑ f. many, abundant;
 long.
पुरूत॑म v. पुरु॑.
पुरूव॑सु a. rich in goods.

पुरोग a. going before, first, excellent, best;
 m.
forerunner, leader, chief (f. आ), adj. led or accompanied by,
furnished with (—˚).
पुरोगा॑ m. = prec.
पुरोगम a. & s. = prec.

पुरोडा॑श m. = prec.;
 offering of (gen.).
पुरोधस् m. appointed priest, house-priest of a king.
पुरोधा॑ f. the office of a house-priest.
पुरोऽनुवाक्य॑वन्त् a. poss. to seq.
पुरोऽनुवाक्या॑ f. invitatory verse ((r.)).

पुरोभागिन् a. obtrusive, troublesome (abstr. ˚गिता
f.*).
पुरोभू॑ a. being in front, excelling (acc.).

पुरोमुख a. turned forward or eastward (with the mouth
or face).
पुरोमूल n. the root of a tree that is turned eastward.
पुरोयु॑ध् a. fighting in front.
पुरो˚योध॑ a. fighting in front.
पुरोवर्तिन् a. being in front or before.
पुरोवात॑ m. wind from before, east wind.
पुरोह॑न् a. destroying castles.
पुरो॑हिति f. the office of the house-priest.
पु॑र्य a. being in a strong place.
पूरणीय a. to be completed, supplied, or satisfied.
पूरय् पूर˚यति v. 1 पृ.

पूर्णक m. a cert. tree;
 f. पूर्णिका a cert. bird.
पूर्णचन्द्र m. the full moon.
पूर्णता f. ˚त्व n. fulness.

पूर्णपात्र॑ m. n., ˚पात्री f. a full vessel or cup;
˚पात्रवृत्त्या plentifully, abundantly.
पूर्ण॑मास् m. the full moon.
पूर्णविंशतिवर्ष a. full twenty years old.
पूर्णश्री a. completely fortunate.

पूर्णामृतांशुवदना f. having a face like the full
moon.
पूर्णार्थ a. having one's wishes fulfilled, successful.
पूर्णिमा f. the day or night of full moon.
पूर्णेच्छ a. whose wish has been fulfilled.
पूर्णेन्दु m. the full moon.

पूर्ति॑ f. fulfilment, reward;
 merit, esp. charity.
पूर्ति॑न् poss. to पूर्त॑.
पूर्त्वन् a. having filled one's self (with food).
पू॑र्पति m. the lord of a castle or city.

पूर्भि॑द् a. breaking castles;
 abstr. ˚र्भिद्य॑ n.
पूर्वकर्मन् n. a former or the first action.
पूर्वकाय m. the fore or upper part of the body.
पूर्वकाल a. of former times.
पूर्वका˚लिक a. of former times.
पूर्वकृत a. done before, n. a former act.
पूर्वग a. going & gone before.
पूर्व˚गत a. going & gone before.
पूर्वग॑त्वन् a. going to meet.

पूर्व॑चित्ति f. foreboding, presentiment, only dat.
forthwith, immediately.
पूर्वचोदित a. mentioned or stated before.
पूर्वजा॑ a. born before, former, ancient.
पूर्वजन॑ m. pl. men of former times, the ancients.
1 पूर्वजन्मन् n. a former birth of life.
2 पूर्वजन्मन् m. the elder brother.
पूर्व˚जा॑वन् a. born before, former, ancient.
पूर्वतस् adv. in front, eastward, first.
पूर्वतस्कर m. a former thief.

पूर्वत्र adv. before, above;
 also = loc. to पू॑र्व.
पूर्वत्व n. precedence, priority, former state.

पूर्व॑था adv. formerly, from old or as of old, at first,
before.
पूर्वदक्षिण a. south-eastern.
पूर्वदत्त a. given before.
पूर्वदिश् f. the eastern region.

पूर्वदृष्ट a. seen before, looked upon by the ancients
as (nom.).
पूर्वदेव m. ˚देवता f. a primal god or deity.
पूर्वदेश m. the eastern region or country.

पूर्वनिपात m. the irregular precedence of an element
of a compound (g.).
पूर्वनिविष्ट a. dug before (tank).
पूर्वपथ m. the former path.
पूर्वपद n. first member of a compound (g.).
पूर्वपाद m. forefoot.
पूर्वपा॑ a. drinking before or first.
पूर्वपा॑य्य n. the first drink.
पूर्वपितामह m. forefather, ancestor.
पूर्व॑पीति f. = पूर्वपा॑य्य.
पूर्वपूर्वोक्त a. the one always mentioned before.
पूर्वपे॑य n. = पूर्वपाय्य.
पूर्वबन्धु m. first i.e. best friend.
पूर्वभाग m. the fore or upper part.
पूर्वभा॑ज् a. receiving the first share, preferred.
पूर्वभुक्ति f. old or long possession.

पूर्वभूभृत् a. the eastern mountain or a former
king.
पूर्वमारिन् a. dying before.
पूर्वमीमां॑सा f. the former Mimansa (ph.).
पूर्वरात्र m. the first part of the night.
2 पूर्वरूप a. having the previous form, being as before.
पूर्वव॑त् adv. as before, as aforesaid.

पूर्ववन्त् a. having or relating to something precedent;
f. ˚वती having been married before.
पूर्वव॑ह् a. drawing in front or for the first time.
(पूर्व˚वा॑ह्) a. drawing in front or for the first time.
पूर्ववाद m. action at law.
पूर्वविद् a. knowing (the things of) the past.
पूर्वविधि m. a preceding rule.
पूर्वविहित a. deposited or buried before (treasure).*

पूर्ववृत्त a. past before;
 n. a former event.
पूर्ववैरिन् m. first i.e. worst foe.
पूर्वशिष्य m. आ f. former pupil.
पूर्वस॑द् a. sitting in front.
पूर्वसभिक m. chief of a gaming house.
पूर्वसमुद्र m. the eastern sea.
पूर्व˚सागर m. the eastern sea.
पूर्वसाहस n. the first or heaviest fine (j.).
पूर्वसू॑ f. first bringing forth.
पूर्व॑हूति f. first invocation, morning prayer.
पूर्वाचल m. the eastern mountain.
पूर्वाचार्य m. an ancient teacher.
पूर्वाद्य a. beginning with the east.
पूर्वाद्रि m. = पूर्वाचल.
पूर्वाधिक a. more important or greater than before.

पूर्वापर a. fore and hind, eastern and western, first
and last, prior and subsequent.

पूर्वार्ध॑काय m. the front or upper part of the
body.
पूर्वावधीरित a. despised before.
पूर्वावेदक m. plaintiff.
पूर्वाह्णिक f. ई relating to the forenoon.
पूर्वी॑ v. पुरु॑.
पूर्वेद्यु॑स् adv. on the day before, yesterday.
पूर्वोक्त a. said or mentioned before.

पूर्वोपकारिन् a. who has rendered a person a service
before.
पूर्वोपनिहित a. deposited before.
